qualifiers: six legs only: spiders don't count

answers.name: Ant
answers.fact: Can carry many times their own body weight.

answers.name: Bee
answers.fact: A honeybee can visit thousands of flowers in a day.

answers.name: Butterfly
answers.fact: Tastes with its feet.

answers.name: Fly
answers.fact: Also tastes with its feet.

answers.name: Mosquito
answers.fact: Only the females bite.

answers.name: Beetle
answers.fact: About a quarter of all known animal species are beetles.

answers.name: Ladybird
answers.fact: Called a ladybug in the US.

answers.name: Grasshopper
answers.fact: Hears with organs on its abdomen.

answers.name: Dragonfly
answers.fact: One of the best hunters on Earth, catching most prey it chases.

answers.name: Moth
answers.fact: Most moths fly at night.

answers.name: Wasp
answers.fact: Paper wasps chew wood into paper for their nests.

answers.name: Cockroach
answers.fact: Can live for a week without its head.

answers.name: Praying mantis
answers.fact: Can turn its head 180 degrees.

answers.name: Cricket
answers.fact: Chirps faster when it's warmer.

answers.name: Termite
answers.fact: Some mounds are taller than a person.

answers.name: Flea
answers.fact: Can jump many times its own body length.

answers.name: Louse
answers.fact: Head lice can't fly or jump.

answers.name: Bedbug
answers.fact: Can survive for months without a meal.

answers.name: Firefly
answers.fact: Its light comes from a chemical reaction.

answers.name: Stick insect

answers.name: Cicada

answers.name: Hornet
answers.fact: The largest wasps.

answers.name: Bumblebee
answers.fact: Can buzz-pollinate flowers by vibrating.

answers.name: Earwig
answers.fact: Doesn't actually crawl into ears.

answers.name: Silverfish
answers.fact: One of the most ancient insects still around.

answers.name: Aphid
answers.fact: Some are born already pregnant.

answers.name: Weevil
answers.fact: A beetle with a long snout.

answers.name: Locust
answers.fact: A grasshopper that swarms.

answers.name: Gnat

answers.name: Midge
answers.fact: Scotland's notorious summer pest.

answers.name: Horsefly
answers.fact: Called a March fly in Australia.

answers.name: Mayfly
answers.fact: Adults can live for as little as a day.

answers.name: Caterpillar
answers.fact: The larva of a butterfly or moth.

answers.name: Fruit fly

answers.name: Stink bug
answers.fact: Releases a smelly chemical when threatened.

answers.name: Dung beetle
answers.fact: Some navigate by the Milky Way.

answers.name: Stag beetle
answers.fact: Males wrestle with giant jaws.

answers.name: Scarab
answers.fact: Sacred in ancient Egypt.

answers.name: Water boatman
answers.fact: Rows through ponds with its legs.

answers.name: Lacewing
answers.fact: Its larvae eat aphids.

answers.name: Damselfly

answers.name: Monarch butterfly
answers.fact: Migrates thousands of kilometres.

answers.name: Leafcutter ant
answers.fact: Farms fungus on the leaves it cuts.

answers.name: Fire ant
answers.fact: Floats in living rafts during floods.

answers.name: Glow worm

answers.name: Hercules beetle
answers.fact: One of the strongest animals for its size.

answers.name: Goliath beetle
answers.fact: One of the heaviest insects.

answers.name: Christmas beetle
answers.fact: Turns up in big numbers around December.

answers.name: Katydid
answers.fact: Named for its 'katy-did' call.

answers.name: Mealybug
answers.fact: A fluffy white sap-sucker.

answers.name: Thrips
answers.fact: Its name is the same singular and plural.

answers.name: Leafhopper
answers.fact: A tiny jumping sap-feeder.

answers.name: Treehopper
answers.fact: Some wear wild helmet shapes.

answers.name: Scale insect
answers.fact: Hides under a waxy shell on plants.

answers.name: Assassin bug
answers.fact: Stabs its prey with a sharp beak.

answers.name: Antlion

answers.name: Caddisfly
answers.fact: Its larvae build cases from sand and twigs.

answers.name: Stonefly

answers.name: Scorpionfly
answers.fact: Males have a scorpion-like tail tip.

answers.name: Sawfly

answers.name: Hoverfly

answers.name: Robber fly

answers.name: Tsetse fly

answers.name: Leaf insect
answers.fact: Looks exactly like a leaf.

answers.name: Orchid mantis
answers.fact: Looks like a flower.

answers.name: Luna moth
answers.fact: A pale green moth with long tails.

answers.name: Blue morpho

answers.name: Death's-head hawkmoth

answers.name: Bombardier beetle

answers.name: Jewel beetle
answers.fact: Glitters with metallic colours.

answers.name: Weta
answers.fact: New Zealand's giant cricket relatives.

answers.name: Webspinner
answers.fact: Spins silk from its front legs.

answers.name: Rock crawler
answers.fact: Lives in cold mountain places.

answers.name: Snakefly
answers.fact: Has a long, snake-like neck.

answers.name: Angel insect
answers.fact: Belongs to one of the least known insect orders.

answers.name: Lord Howe Island stick insect
answers.fact: Thought extinct, then rediscovered on Ball's Pyramid in 2001.
